notes: The submitted report contains no substantive incident findings, only a meta statement that a prior report exists. Therefore none of the planted defects can be credited as found.
The submitted report contains no substantive incident findings, root causes, or defect identifications. It therefore misses every planted defect.

The report correctly identifies the checkout promo NPE and the inventory-svc OOM/CrashLoop/no-endpoints 503 storm. It misses most planted root causes, especially the Kafka retention change, unauthorized scale-down, admin cache reload, unindexed JSONB lookup as the definitive memory driver, and several independent defects.

The report correctly recognized the SMTP TLS-version incompatibility affecting notify-svc, but most other findings stop at surface symptoms rather than the planted root causes. It also misattributes the main outage to inventory asyncpg pool/replica issues and treats red-herring cache eviction and chronyd noise as meaningful defects.
